# Laptop Security Baseline

Every company laptop must meet this baseline before it can access internal systems.

## Requirements

Full disk encryption must be enabled. The screen locks automatically after 5 minutes of inactivity. Operating system security updates must be installed within 14 days of release.

## Authentication

Every employee receives a Tollgate 5C hardware key, which is required for single sign-on and for SSH access to production.

## Lost devices

A lost or stolen laptop must be reported to the security team within one hour so that the device can be wiped remotely.
